description: Fader and VCA, 3HP, with a mute button

params.text: Sets the level from the input to the output, -60dB to +6dB
Silences the output while it is on

inputs.text: Anything above 0.5V here silences the output
0-10V attenuated by the fader, setting the level
The signal into the fader; the channels patched here set the module's polyphony

outputs.text: The input signal after the fader and the mute

menu: Linear level CV response — the level CV inputs act linearly in amplitude, so 5V halves the level the fader sets, instead of acting in decibels
